question: Can a bounded local repair by the original joint owner satisfy the unchanged grounding contract while preserving its shorter observed path?
selection_constraint: Existing qa-candidate-package/README.md eligibility rule: apply unchanged QA01..06 priorities among alternatives satisfying common required endpoints, permissions and device conditions. Missing QA01 endpoints cannot support an overall speed winner. Preserve all faster observed A paths and failures. No new correctness threshold, composite score, imputation or penalty.

proposed_configurations.A2: Actual expression-level patch merge on rejection: per-expression unchanged common geometry validation selects affected IDs; the same joint owner returns those patches, host preserves unaffected entries and revalidates the complete set. The owner may request full_rejudgment:true within the same sole recovery; unresolved semantics never become fixed truth.
proposed_configurations.A5: Only on recovery, raw pointer/path coordinate union with constant128px padding; no designated cue => whole frame. No rescaling; grid every100 original pixels. Original pixels and old event overlay remain supplied. Explicit view_pixels/view_id boxes are inverse-mapped mechanically; unknown views, wrong frame, malformed/overflow boxes are rejected without clamping. Actual rendering occurs after INPUT_CAPTURED and is included in latency/RSS.
prohibited: native object geometry absent from the scenario
clamping a proposed bbox into correctness
replacing missing targets using the speech count
turning a producer output into the final binder

proposed_configurations.change: None to the previously frozen B4 mechanism. Initial screen/speech calls overlap within the same shared slot cap. Fresh repetitions control service-time epoch; prior B/B4 records remain evidence.

population.order: Finish all24 BASIC first, then all24 TACTIC. Within each phase, repetitions1/3 list first variant then second; repetition2 reverses them; every case is retained in original fixture order.

predeclared_readout.functional_acceptance: Use the pre-existing common endpoint/admissibility contract: resolved substantive callback for all15 inputs, final required revision completion for all12 goals, source/currentness/access and unaltered geometry/count/type validation. This is finite common functionality, not a new product accuracy threshold. QA02 exact-set accuracy remains separately reported at priority2 and is not redefined.
predeclared_readout.latency: Report whole-population coverage plus conditional means and per-case endpoints. No overall speed winner from incomplete populations. The old A-observed 10-endpoint intersection is descriptive only and never replaces the 15-input denominator.
predeclared_readout.accuracy: Unchanged exact first-adopted referent set and revision; rejected correct-ID proposals remain failures if no valid adoption follows.
predeclared_readout.remaining_qas: All producer/recovery cost, calls/tokens, causal spans and fresh-worker same-sample RSS are included. Tactic QA04 remains N/A unless actual change exercises are separately authorized.
predeclared_readout.negative_result: If the new tactic remains incomplete or removes the shorter path, preserve that result; do not narrate it as a successful QA01-first mitigation. B4 superiority, ties and reversals remain possible.
predeclared_readout.selection: Among common-contract-complete configurations, compare QA01 first, then unchanged lower priorities. An incomplete conditional mean cannot select the overall speed winner; if only B qualifies in BASIC, state that as endpoint-eligibility conditional selection, not an inversion in favor of QA02. Tactics never overwrite BASIC outcomes. If A2+A5 fails or costs its speed advantage, report this negative result.

before_any_live_call: Parent explicitly approved48 runs and DP04cap$.55 within shared$.1.50. Exclusive measurement window coordinated with DP02.
Offline affine round-trip, source provenance, malformed patch, stale revision, count/type and uncertainty regressions pass without oracle access by the candidate.
Crop padding, scale/tick rules, fallback and merge schema are frozen independent of the answer sets.
The plan, source/binary, fixture/oracle, model settings, run order, caps, failure handling and memory scope receive explicit immutable hashes.
If review reveals a common required-function bug, stop treating its correction as a tactic and agree an A/B common baseline comparison before calls.
api_preflight: Credential availability only, secret values never emitted. Actual endpoint/model validity checked by the first already-planned paid call, with usage/failure included; no uncounted model smoke.
definition_limitations: A2+A5 is an explicit combined tactic; no separate causal attribution to crop/grid versus patching.
No new screen producer or native semantic geometry is injected.
Replayed old proposals remain control replay, not a provider late-return experiment.
QA04 for the new combination is N/A; no new modification exercises authorized.
No claim that a coordinate view or joint/producer ownership guarantees accuracy.
